shorts.hook: Why do kids in Germany walk with lanterns in November?
shorts.spoken: Why do kids in Germany walk through the dark with lanterns every November?

shorts.hook: Why does Karneval start at 11:11 on 11.11?
shorts.spoken: Why does Karneval start at eleven minutes past eleven, on the eleventh of November?

shorts.hook: Why do so many people in Germany eat goose on 11 November?
shorts.spoken: Why do so many people in Germany eat goose on the eleventh of November?

shorts.hook: A Roman soldier cut his cloak in two. Germany still celebrates it.
shorts.spoken: A Roman soldier cut his cloak in two. Sixteen hundred years later, Germany still celebrates it.
